BuiltInDebugMenus: For limited testing of DialogueTree functionality and progression, the Tree Tester widget provides a quick way to step through any tree and display text. To use the Tree Tester as an Editor Utility Widget, open the 'KPlugins' dropdown toolbar at the top of the main Level Editor window and select 'Tree Tester'.
Title: KDialogueSystem
Overview: This system provides a workflow for creating branching dialogue trees as Blueprints.
QuickReference: A DialogueTree is a Blueprintable class that provides built-in functions to construct traversable branching dialogue structures. DialogueTrees are built within the Blueprint editor using 5 functions: Root(), Step(), Path(), Branch(), and Subtree(). Each function takes a set of input parameters, the main one being DialogueInstructions. All DialogueTrees can be nested as subtrees within other trees.
DialogueInstructions are structs used to pass dialogue content into the core Step(), Path(), and Branch() functions within a DialogueTree.
A DialogueChoice is text paired with a settable bool that determines if the choice is included when processing a Branch().
